image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown from a top-down perspective, resting on a dark, wet substrate of decaying leaves and twigs. The salamander has a glossy black body with bright yellow spots and stripes along its back and sides. Its body is elongated and cylindrical, with short limbs visible. The tail extends behind it, appearing laterally compressed. The surrounding environment is dark and moist, consistent with the salamander's natural habitat.
